resources.string: Save everything in one file, or bring it back on this or a new phone.
No backup made yet on this phone
One file with everything: documents with their photos and PDFs, products, prices, lots, what the app learned from you and your settings. Not included: the AI model and the log.
Without this password the backup cannot be opened, not even by you. Write it down and keep it apart from the file. Then choose where to save it: Drive, a folder, a USB stick.
The backup could not be completed. Nothing on the phone was changed.
Documents are being read. Wait until they are done, then try again.
Replaces everything on this phone with what is in the backup. The file is checked completely before anything is changed.
Type the password of this backup.
This file is not a Kitchen Receipts backup.
The backup file is damaged or incomplete. Nothing on the phone was changed.
This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app first.
Backup made on %1$s, with %2$d documents (business: %3$s). Everything now on this phone will be replaced by it. The app will close and open again.
If the phone breaks or gets lost, everything recorded is gone. Tap to make one.
